review_notes: I read the whole file. It declares no @[simp] lemmas and no local simp sets. Its statements are Tendsto, IsBigO, IsLittleO and IsTheta results that take hypotheses, which are not natural simp rewrite rules. Simp is only called inside proofs (`simpa`, `simp_rw`). Those calls use ordinary lemmas such as Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, Real.div_rpow and rpow_inv_le_iff_of_pos, or an `(disch := positivity)` discharger. I found no competing rules, no rewrite in the wrong direction, no unwanted expansion and no credible cycle. I grepped the Pow directory for @[simp] attributes and for `sqrt_eq_rpow` and `rpow_inv_le_iff_of_pos`, but I did not read each simp-lemma definition in full. I did not find a missing canonical simp lemma that would clearly improve actual uses, and I did not want to propose simp attributes just because an identity looks simple. I could not run Lean, so I make no claim about simp behaviour beyond reading the sources.
